1. How to Analyze Water?
Click on 'Detect via Camera' or 'Upload from Gallery'. Point the camera at a water sample or select an image. The AI will tell you if it's Safe or Unsafe.

2. How to Submit a Report?
After analysis, click the green 'Submit Report' button. This will send your GPS location and result to the Admin.

3. How to View Map?
Click on 'Water Quality Map' to see reports from all analysts.

4. Contact Support:
Email: support@waterquality.com
